assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology and incretin-based therapy form a clear, specific discovery chain from the incretin effect and proglucagon processing to GLP-1 as a glucose-dependent insulin secretagogue and satiety signal, with a transformative change in treating type 2 diabetes and obesity and wide secondary effects on cardiovascular and renal outcomes.
assessment.attribution: Holst (identification and physiology of active GLP-1), Mojsov (peptide identification and early characterization of the active form) and Drucker (GLP-1 and GLP-2 biology, therapeutic translation) are the most defensible trio; Knudsen is central to liraglutide/semaglutide development but is more drug-development than discovery, and the Mojsov credit is sometimes contested in public accounts.
assessment.maturity: Decades of independent confirmation, large randomized outcome trials and global clinical uptake make recognition clearly mature and arguably overdue.
uncertainties: Allocation of credit among Holst, Mojsov, Drucker, Habener and others is debated and I have not verified the details independently.
Whether the committee prefers to recognize drug development (Knudsen) alongside basic physiology.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics gave neuroscience and physiology a general method to control genetically defined cells with light, grounded in the discovery of channelrhodopsins, and has changed experimental practice across the field.
assessment.attribution: Nagel and Hegemann identified and characterized channelrhodopsin as a light-gated cation channel; Deisseroth and Boyden established its use in neurons and behavior, with Miesenboeck and Bamberg also credited. A three-person limit forces difficult exclusions; I favor the channelrhodopsin discovery plus Deisseroth as the principal neuroscience translator.
assessment.maturity: Widely adopted for over fifteen years with extensive independent confirmation; recognition is timely. Clinical translation (vision restoration) is only beginning but is not required for a methodological discovery.
uncertainties: Dispute over priority between Boyden, Deisseroth and others for first neuronal demonstration.
Method/tool versus discovery framing and the number of deserving contributors exceeding three.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response revealed a new intracellular signaling pathway from the endoplasmic reticulum to the nucleus (Ire1, Hac1/XBP1 splicing, ATF6) with broad relevance to secretory-cell physiology, diabetes, neurodegeneration and cancer.
assessment.attribution: Walter and Mori delineated the core pathway in yeast and mammals, and credit appears clean and compact, though Ron's work on the PERK/eIF2 arm is related and not on this credited list.
assessment.maturity: Foundational mechanism, thoroughly confirmed across organisms; clinical derivatives are still developing but the basic science is mature and a Nobel precedent exists for adjacent cell biology.
uncertainties: The relationship to the integrated stress response and the work of others not credited here.
Whether the committee wants stronger disease-level impact.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Virus-like particle HPV vaccines prevent persistent infection and cervical and other HPV-related cancers, with national programs now showing sharply reduced precancer and cancer incidence; a major preventive-medicine achievement.
assessment.attribution: Lowy and Schiller developed L1 VLP assembly and its immunogenicity; Frazer (with Zhou) developed the VLP expression approach and early vaccine work. Others, such as Zhou (deceased) and zur Hausen's earlier prize for the virus link, complicate the narrative.
assessment.maturity: Strong real-world effectiveness evidence from Scandinavian and other cohorts; timely and mature.
uncertainties: Credit overlap and disputes about priority among the VLP groups.
Prior Nobel recognition of HPV-cancer link may make the committee view this as already partly honored.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: cGAS-STING defines how cytosolic DNA is sensed by innate immunity, connecting infection, autoimmunity (interferonopathies), cancer immunity and senescence, with a clear mechanism-level insight and growing therapeutic interest.
assessment.attribution: Chen identified cGAS and the second messenger cGAMP; Barber identified STING. Ishikawa co-discovered STING and the supplied credit list is large, so a two- or three-person configuration is plausible but contested.
assessment.maturity: Roughly a decade old with strong confirmation of mechanism; therapeutic validation is still limited, so recognition may be slightly early.
uncertainties: Clinical impact not yet established through approved drugs.
Distribution of credit for STING between Barber and Ishikawa and for cGAS between Chen and others.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Wnt signaling is a fundamental pathway in development, stem-cell maintenance and cancer, traceable from Int1 insertional activation in mouse mammary tumors to Wingless homology and conserved signaling.
assessment.attribution: Nusse and Varmus discovered Int1/Wnt1 as a proto-oncogene; later pathway work by many others (Wingless genetics, beta-catenin, Frizzled) is not on this list and could argue for broader credit.
assessment.maturity: Very mature and heavily confirmed; the impact on developmental biology is lasting, though Varmus already holds a Nobel for the cellular origin of retroviral oncogenes.
uncertainties: Varmus's prior prize and the breadth of the Wnt field complicate a fair configuration.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Genetically engineered CAR-T cells produced durable remissions in refractory B-cell malignancies and created a new cell-therapy class, with several approved products.
assessment.attribution: June and Sadelain advanced CD19 CAR designs with costimulation into clinical use, and Rosenberg contributed adoptive T-cell therapy and early clinical CAR demonstration; Eshhar and others are relevant but not in this credited set.
assessment.maturity: Clinical effect is well confirmed, though long-term safety, solid-tumor limits and ongoing evolution mean the field may still be maturing.
uncertainties: Foundational contributions by Eshhar and others omitted from the credited list.
Immaturity in solid tumors and toxicity profile.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: TOR/mTOR signaling is the central regulator linking nutrients and growth factors to cell growth, with implications for metabolism, aging, cancer and immunosuppression.
assessment.attribution: Hall discovered TOR genes as the targets of rapamycin in yeast; Sabatini identified mammalian mTOR and its nutrient-sensing pathways, while Schreiber's FKBP12-rapamycin chemical biology is also decisive. Credit allocation is genuinely uncertain.
assessment.maturity: Highly mature and replicated; clinical consequences are real (rapalogs) though less transformative than the leading candidates.
uncertainties: Allocation among Hall, Sabatini, Schreiber and others such as Abraham and Sabers is unresolved.
Personal controversies around one credited scientist could affect configuration; not verified by me.
